roadmap.note: Play the opening missions and finish the first two chapters. Chapter trophies pop as you go.
roadmap.title: Step 1 — Story: Chapters 1–2

roadmap.note: Finish the campaign. The gold final-mission trophy pops at the end.
roadmap.title: Step 2 — Story: Chapters 3–4 and the finale

roadmap.note: Close out Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — one final mission each.
roadmap.title: Step 3 — Character finales

roadmap.note: Eight stranger strands, all nine activity types, races, fishing, bowling and meditation.
roadmap.title: Step 4 — Strangers, activities and races

roadmap.note: All 52 areas, card sets, WAiNK spots, vehicles, garages and spending — plus the missables in the box below.
roadmap.title: Step 5 — Explore Leonida and collect

roadmap.note: Stunts, shooting range gold, challenges, heists, and the 100% completion push. The platinum pops last.
roadmap.title: Step 6 — Combat, heists and clean-up

1.text: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is no separate task — finish everything else and this unlocks on its own.

10.text: Complete the Child's Play mission. A story mission — play it through to the end.

11.text: Complete the Headliners mission. A story mission — finish it and the trophy pops.

12.text: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. A story mission — play it through to the end.

13.text: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — finish the operation and it pops.

14.text: Reach 100% completion. The long one: finish the story, all stranger strands, collectibles, activities and challenges. The in-game stats page shows exactly what is left — work through it group by group.

15.text: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count. Stunts add up naturally while driving; mop up the rest by chaining jumps off ramps and hills.

16.text: Try each of the 9 activity types once: races, shooting range, fishing, bowling, arcade, meditation, drone races, hunting and one more the map offers. One try each is enough — no need to win.

17.text: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's target pattern first, then go for gold one challenge at a time — steady aim beats speed.

18.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's shortcuts; the drone handles like a light aircraft, so take the corners wide and smooth.

19.text: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — street, off-road, boat, air. Enter a race, win it, move on; 20 distinct wins unlocks it.

2.text: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to the end. It unlocks when the mission completes — you cannot miss it in the story.

20.text: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish where Cal fishes, match the bait to the spot, and reel in a bigger catch than his.

21.text: Finish one arcade game. Pick any cabinet, play to the end of a game — no high score needed.

22.text: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's strand through to its last mission — the trophy pops at the end of it.

23.text: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's strand through to its last mission.

24.text: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's strand through to its last mission.

25.text: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map — work through eight full strands, one after another.

26.text: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand through to its last mission.

27.text: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's strand through to its last mission.

28.text: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The spots are marked once you find the first one — visit each and meditate.

29.text: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's lead to the animal's territory and take it down.

3.text: Finish Chapter 1. Story progress only — keep playing the main missions and it pops at the chapter close.

30.text: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up as you explore and finish three full sets.

31.text: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the app at different spots around the map; each new location counts once.

32.text: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more — they tick off as you play; check the challenges list for what is left.

33.missable_note: Your partner is only available during story windows — do it while they are riding with you.
33.text: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Build heat with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.

34.text: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row, keep the heat, and get away clean.

35.text: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive anything new and it counts — the tracker shows how many you have found.

36.text: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before the meter runs out.

37.missable_note: Tied to a story sequence at the airport — take the unscheduled exit when the moment comes.
37.text: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport without following the usual route — the trigger is the departure itself.

38.text: Deal with the Rhinos (tanks). Take one on in free roam with heavy weapons, or hijack one and cause chaos.

39.text: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you — and get out clean.

4.text: Finish Chapter 2. Same deal: main story only, it pops when the chapter ends.

40.text: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults are high-heat jobs — plan the escape route before you go in.

41.text: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop a truck, crack it open, and lose the heat.

42.text: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive every road and visit every named area.

43.text: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang and hit it.

44.missable_note: Tied to an early-game story beat on Ocean Beach — stop for the cocktail before the story moves on.
44.text: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beach bar, order a cocktail, and take in the view.

45.text: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through the showroom glass and out the other side.

46.text: Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Follow through a full game — strikes help, but finishing is what counts.

47.text: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This one pops from a story beat with your partner — keep playing and it comes.

48.missable_note: Choices are one-time — if you rush the story without choosing, the count can stall short of 500.
48.text: Make choices — the game tracks a count up to 500. Say yes whenever the game offers a decision: dialogue choices, side-job calls and story forks all count.

49.missable_note: If you clear everything first try, the 'second time' trigger may never fire — leave one retry on purpose.
49.text: Succeed on a second try. Fail something, then clear it on the retry — the trophy is about the comeback.

5.text: Finish Chapter 3. Story only — no side work needed.

50.missable_note: A one-off event — if you walk past it, it may not repeat.
50.text: Witness something strange. A one-off odd event somewhere in Leonida — keep your eyes open while exploring.

51.missable_note: Easy to forget once you rely on guns — do it early, before melee stops being your tool.
51.text: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Drive past at low speed and swing — one clean hit does it.

52.text: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Feed marked bills to your contacts over time until the total hits $250,000.

53.text: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food and gear — spending adds up fast across a playthrough.

54.text: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the map — they double as vehicle storage.

55.text: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the app, and register them — ten registrations unlocks it.

6.text: Finish Chapter 4. Story only — it pops at the chapter close.

7.text: Finish the final mission. The gold story trophy — it pops at the end of the campaign.

8.text: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. A story mission — play it through to the end and the trophy follows.

9.text: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story mission — finish the heist and it pops.
